durable_memory.title: Coverage closure must be executable, not rhetorical
durable_memory.rule: A continuity identifier may be classified as coverage-relative unlocated only through a retained event that proves complete ref inventory, complete reachable-history traversal, complete pagination, no unresolved permission error, no provider-ceiling ambiguity, and a digest-bound resolution for every target identifier.
durable_memory.effect: The prior provenance closure lattice is now enforceable by code rather than dependent on prose interpretation.

observed: M-004, M-005, and M-006 remain unresolved in the canonical queue.
The prior lattice defines closure requirements but does not mechanically reject malformed or incomplete coverage events.
The connected repository search surface did not produce exhaustive all-ref and all-reachable-commit evidence in this run.
inferred: Without an executable gate, future automation prose could accidentally promote an unresolved identifier to unlocated despite incomplete coverage.
proposed: Use tools/continuity/validate-provenance-coverage-event.mjs as the acceptance gate for future coverage events.
Generate the first production coverage event only from an authenticated exhaustive ref and reachable-history enumerator.
superseded: Treating a human-readable coverage statement as sufficient closure evidence.
Allowing a located source whose assigning commit is outside the retained reachable-commit set.
Allowing unlocated status while provider ceilings, permissions, pagination, or reachable-history completeness remain ambiguous.
unresolved: Immutable assigning sources for M-004, M-005, and M-006.
A production exhaustive coverage event over all accessible refs and reachable commits.

verified_behaviors: reject located source outside retained graph

privacy_boundary: Only opaque continuity identifiers, repository metadata, coverage semantics, and validator behavior are persisted. No private dialogue, personal history, health information, credentials, or account data are included.
limitations: This run did not execute an authenticated exhaustive branch, tag, and reachable-commit traversal.
The validator proves event integrity and closure preconditions; it does not itself enumerate Git objects.
M-004, M-005, and M-006 therefore remain unresolved.
